resources.title: GCC Warning Options: enum switch diagnostics
resources.reason: Distinguish default-suppressed switch diagnostics from switch-enum policy.

inspection.method: Opened primary manual and read the named paragraphs; compared against actual GCC/Clang probes separately.
inspection.scope: -Wswitch suppresses a missing-enumerator warning when default exists; -Wswitch-enum still diagnoses omitted enumerators.
inspection.limits: Only these diagnostic paragraphs; no whole-manual inspection or ISO exhaustiveness claim.

inspection_note: Rust enum introduction/constructor/value and match scrutinee/binding/guard passages reread2026-10-18; existing exact source identities retained. C11 draft authority remains bounded; no published C17/C23 inspection.
